title: Moniq feature catalog entry
description: One entry per product feature domain. Used to catalog what exists, where it lives, and (once PostHog has usage data) how important/used it is — see docs/features/README.md.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, matches the features/<id> folder name where applicable.

domain.description: Same as id; kept as an explicit field for readability in tooling that flattens entries.

description.description: One or two sentences: what this feature does and who it's for.

routes.description: App Router paths (locale-relative, e.g. /budget) that this feature owns. Empty for infrastructure/shared domains with no dedicated route.

keyActions.description: The primary user actions this feature supports, in plain language (e.g. "create transaction", "approve bank import").

postHogEvents.description: PostHog event names (snake_case) that should be emitted via lib/analytics/posthog.ts's trackFeatureEvent for this feature's key actions. May be empty if instrumentation hasn't been added yet — see docs/analytics.md.

status.description: Whether this feature is shipped in the web app today, or planned/partial.

priority.description: Ranked importance/usage score. Null until real PostHog usage data exists — see docs/features/README.md for how this gets computed.

platforms.description: Which client(s) currently implement this feature.
